FOREST (SIND AMENDMENT) ACTz, 1972
An
act to amend the Forest Act, 1927, to its application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th
December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 28th December 1972).
No.
PAS/Legis-19/72.-The Forest (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1972 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 22nd December 1971 and assented to by
the Governor of Sind on the 28th December 1972 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sind:
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the Forest (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Amendment of section 67 of Act XVI of 1927

No.
PAS/Legis-19/72.-The Forest (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1972 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 22nd December 1971 and assented to by
the Governor of Sind on the 28th December 1972 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sind:
2. Amendment of section 67 of Act XVI of
1927.--In the Forest Act, 1927, in its application to the Province of Sind,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 67, for the words
"Magistrate of the first class", the words "Special Executive
Magistrate" shall be substituted.

the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 22nd December 1971 and assented to by

the Legislature of Sind:
3. Amendment of section 68 of Act XVI of
1927.--In the said Act, In section 68, for subsection (3) the following
subsection shall be substituted, namely:-
"(3)
A Forest officer shall not be empowered under this section unless be is a
Forest officer of a rank not inferior to that of a Ranger, and the sum of money
accepted as compensation under clause (a) of subsection (1) shall in no case
exceed the sum of five hundred rupees".

"For
each Elephant
Fifty rupees.
For each
Camel

For each

Twenty-five

For each

rupees".

the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 22nd December 1971 and assented to by
the Governor of Sind on the 28th December 1972 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sind:
5. Addition of section 79-A to Act XVI of
1927.--In the said Act, after section 79, the following new section shall
be added, namely:-
"79-A.
Requisition of police assistance.-If any Forest Officer authorised to take
action under this Act requires police assistance in the exercise of his powers
thereunder he may send requisition to the officer in charge of a police station
who shall on such requisition render the assistance required".
